title: Named permissions for notes
prompt: Admins (users whose roles include "admin") must be able to delete any note; other users may only delete their own. Create src/permissions.ts exporting `access`, made with Inferlo's permissions(), with two permissions: "notes.delete" (the note's owner or an admin) and "notes.stats" (only users with the "admin" role). Pass it to createApp in src/app.ts. DELETE /notes/:id must use access to check "notes.delete": a user who is neither the owner nor an admin gets a 403 with error code IL3004 and the note stays. Add `export const noteStats` in src/routes/notes.ts: GET /notes/stats returning { total } (the number of all notes), allowed only with the "notes.stats" permission, checked by the route itself.
